questions.question: 讲讲 DeepSeekMoE。它与 Mixtral 这类标准的 top-2 MoE 有何不同？
questions.questionEn: Walk me through DeepSeekMoE. How is it different from a standard top-2 MoE like Mixtral?

questions.question: DeepSeek-V3 使用无辅助损失的负载均衡。辅助损失有什么问题，bias 技巧又是如何起作用的？
questions.questionEn: DeepSeek-V3 uses auxiliary-loss-free load balancing. What was wrong with the auxiliary loss, and how does the bias trick work?

questions.question: 什么是 multi-token prediction（MTP），为什么要用它来训练？
questions.questionEn: What is multi-token prediction (MTP) and why train with it?

questions.question: 用 PyTorch 实现带共享专家的 top-k MoE 路由，并指出其中在效率与正确性上的陷阱。
questions.questionEn: Implement top-k MoE routing with a shared expert in PyTorch, and point out the efficiency and correctness traps.

questions.topicName: 推理、服务与 GPU 性能
questions.question: 请描述在 GPU 显存受限的情况下，你会如何以低 latency 服务一个 671B 参数的 MoE 模型。
questions.questionEn: Sketch how you would serve a 671B-parameter MoE model with low latency under GPU-memory constraints.

questions.question: R1-Zero 完全用 RL 训练，基本没有先做 SFT。这说明了什么，为什么完整的 R1 又把 SFT 加了回来？
questions.questionEn: R1-Zero was trained with RL and essentially no SFT first. What did that show, and why did full R1 add SFT back?

questions.question: 在 671B 规模上做 FP8 训练非常困难。低精度下究竟哪里会出问题，你如何让它保持稳定？
questions.questionEn: FP8 training at 671B scale is hard. What actually breaks in low precision, and how do you make it stable?

questions.question: 当大部分数据都是合成数据时，你如何构建训练数据集而不触发模型崩溃（model collapse）？
questions.questionEn: How do you build a training dataset without triggering model collapse when much of your data is synthetic?

questions.question: DualPipe 在训练中让计算与通信重叠。为什么在这个规模下这种重叠是决定性的，代价又是什么？
questions.questionEn: DualPipe overlaps computation and communication in training. Why is that overlap the whole game at this scale, and what is the trade-off?

questions.question: DeepSeek 声称以通常训练成本的一小部分取得了前沿级的结果。如果面试官问“这怎么可能”，你会怎样结构化地回答？
questions.questionEn: DeepSeek claims frontier-class results at a fraction of the usual training cost. If an interviewer asks “how is that even possible,” what is your structured answer?
